description: This is a shell script used for testing Git submodule operations and cherry-pick handling, particularly focusing on submodule conflicts and behavior.

methods.name: test_submodule_switch
methods.description: Switches to the specified submodule and verifies its state.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with specific commands.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository in the specified directory.

methods.name: test_config_global
methods.description: Sets global git configuration options for testing.
